notes.title: "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" Translated version released today!
notes.notes:
Finally, today, February 8, at 4:00 p.m., the worldwide version of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" has been released!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2106810/

In addition to the previously released Japanese version, the new version includes four new languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean.
The result of more than half a year of careful translation work is finally available for everyone to enjoy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/de23ab06f0da620005de394cd2332aa32d1dff83.png[/img]

In this worldwide version, all characters appearing in the work have been translated, so game players who cannot read Japanese can play the game to the end without worry.
The game is a "Japanese horror" game in every language, so once you start up the game, you will be drawn deeper and deeper into the world of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain"......
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/f02787cae82eabc0e13702e8e4b801a38a8d2a7d.png[/img]

The worldwide version also reflects a major update that was made the day before yesterday.
Please take a look at the detailed background of the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/cbd8ad932b344fd1f777ad3b5ef2a5a237f32cf4.png[/img]

The price is $15.99.
Experience the "mysterious horror" that takes place in the Japanese countryside with the main character, Shiori Kanzaki.

notes.title: "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" worldwide version 2 days ago!
notes.notes:
The worldwide version of  "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" will be released at 16:00 Japan time on Wednesday, February 8!

The story takes place in rural Japan in the 1990s.
It is a multi-ending horror game that depicts an "experience" in a small village where traditions still remain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/01e44fffae8993c9128411d533dd2ea8de137012.jpg[/img]

The game offers a "horror" experience in a Japanese village, but also draws your attention to the relationships between the characters.

The main character is a college student and the manager of the village museum.
A junior high school student who doesn't fit in, and a policeman.
And the villagers who live in the area.

The story they create is a profound one that cannot be summed up in a single word, "horror game.

The many different endings that can be reached through the many branches of the story will leave you with different emotions after playing the game.

We look forward to the worldwide release of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain".

notes.title: Major update to the "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" remake
notes.notes:
A major update (ver. 2.0.6) of the remake "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" will be released today, Monday, February 6, at 18:00 JST!

The remake version, which was first released in Japanese in 2022, has upgraded the visual and story aspects from the previous version released in 2013, and was a big hit among fans.
This major update further enhances these aspects.
The new version has been further enhanced with a variety of "expressions" in various scenes so that everyone can immerse themselves more fully in the world of the film.

[b](1) Power up the visual aspect[/b]
The exterior of the Azakawa Village Museum, the Child Eater Cave, and the ruins of an abandoned mine have been given more vivid details, and the stamps that can be collected in the "Stamp Rally" mini-game now have different designs for each location.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/337e50e8ebfb572b5e83c5896c61e789a7ad20bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/d5c877770649742a4f0202cef8f01f973e2af5b2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/cbd8ad932b344fd1f777ad3b5ef2a5a237f32cf4.png[/img]

[b](2) Brushed up production - new missions introduced.[/b]
New scenarios have also been added for users who have already experienced the game to the fullest.
In order to solve "new problems" for the residents of Azakawa Village, you can try your hand at "catching chickens" and "gathering wild vegetables".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/d805958aa77b29287df5b6c6b84384954bc4ad8c.png[/img]


These updates will also be reflected in the translated versions (English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean) to be released the day after tomorrow.
For those of you who are interested in the remake of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain," and for those of you who have already done a lot of work on it, I urge you to step into Azakawa Village!


To purchase, please visit the Steam Store page below

notes.title: The remake of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" is now available for Mac OS today!
notes.notes:
Today, January 20 (Friday) at 8:00 p.m., the Mac version of the game, which is developed and marketed by Apple for Mac PCs, is now available.
Until now, only Windows users have been able to play the remake of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain," but now Mac users can finally play it as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/25a1d10a6652758675ef7f9232c876e9bebc6bf2.jpg[/img]
This is the first time that a Mac version of a Game Magazine piece has been distributed.
We have taken some time to prepare for this, and the Windows version was released on Wednesday, November 16, 2011, after a period of time had passed since then.

We are working on the Mac version of the English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean versions, which are scheduled for release on February 8 (Wed.).

We hope that through this Mac version, we can deliver the charm of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" to as many people as possible, and that they will feel like Shiori and enjoy their days in Aza River Village to the fullest.

notes.title: English version of the remake "The Forest of Drizzling" February 8!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience.
The remake version of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain," which was first released in Japanese on November 16 last year, will be available worldwide on February 8, Japan time.
Finally, more and more people will be able to enjoy the game beyond the borders of Japan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/9e6f3030d3367dbbe8653841bfabb9b4f39c96fb.jpg[/img]
The following four languages will be newly added.
The following four languages will be newly added to the game, which will translate not only the conversations between the characters, but also all other text that appears in the game, allowing players to experience a different worldview from that of the Japanese version.

・English
・Simplified Chinese
・Traditional Chinese
・Korean

The price for the English version is $15.99.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42786794/d12625cb034f98961b782a009d76e8c2a133b727.png[/img]
We had been aiming to release the game this month, but we have postponed the release date in order to deliver a more satisfactory quality to our players. ......
The translation work is still in progress, but the Game Magazine staff strongly feels that we are steadily producing a great product.

Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Remake of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" Steam Store Page Released!
notes.notes:
A remake of the multi-ed horror game "The Forest of Drizzling Rain", originally published on October 11, 2013 on Freem! will release a remake of the multi-ed horror game "The Drizzling Forest" on Steam in the fall of 2022!
The Steam store page opened yesterday at 18:00 JST.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2106810/

As you may be surprised to learn from the "About This Game" section of the store page and the teaser PV that was released at the same time, the story and visuals in this remake have been drastically redesigned.
You can walk around with Shiori in the newly drawn map of "Azakawa Village"!

The following is an excerpt from a blog post updated after the store opened, in which the original author, Makoto Sanada, talks about the story behind the work.

゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。

--We have prepared a scenario in which you are free to roam around Azakawa Village.
To this end, I have been working with the visual creator of the map to envision a variety of specific scenes.

The atmosphere of a rural mountain village, the scenic and unexpected spots there, and the slightly unsettling and mysterious places that have existed in the village for a long time. ......Shiori, Suka, Sakuma, Officer Mochizuki, and the residents of Azakawa Village, what kind of place and how do they spend their days? What kind of place and how do the residents of Azakawa Village spend their days?

We have tried to convey the atmosphere and scenery of the place.

We hope that the players will be able to feel the atmosphere and scenery of the Azakawa Village, and that they will be able to spend as much time there as Shiori and her friends do.

This has also led to a significant increase in new scenarios and dialogues.

I am sure that you will be able to see many aspects of Azakawa Village this time around.
This includes not only Shiori and her friends, but also the ordinary people living in Azakawa Village.

This remake of "The Forest of Drizzling Rain" I hope to deliver it in a way that will make you feel fresh and new!

Quote.https://hskzkrnkrn.com/blog/1586/

゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。゜。
